$comment: item-map.json — the auditable bridge between Minecraft Wiki names and Voxelhaven items.
Used only by tools/build-recipes.mjs (a development tool); the game never reads it.
Resolution order for one wiki ingredient name:
2. `patterns` — a regular expression, tried in order. Used for the wood
families (48 log/wood/stem/hyphae names and 13 plank names) where an
exhaustive list would be noise. Every name a pattern resolves is
printed by the builder, so the mapping stays auditable.
3. Otherwise the name is unmapped: the recipe is reported and skipped.
A name is only listed here when Voxelhaven genuinely has the item. Nothing
is mapped onto a lookalike to inflate the recipe count.

patterns.note: Every Overworld log and bark block is one Timber block in Voxelhaven.
Nether stems are bark blocks too; Voxelhaven has a single wood type.
All plank species collapse onto Voxelhaven's single Planks block.

logs.note: The wiki's `Any Log`/`Matching <species> Log` alias family.

planks.note: The wiki's `Any Planks` / `Matching Overworld Planks` alias family.

stone_tier.note: The wiki's `Any stone-tier block`. Only cobblestone exists in Voxelhaven; blackstone and cobbled deepslate are deliberately not aliased onto it.

voxelhavenRecipes.why: Voxelhaven's original fiber-to-canopy recipe, kept from the flat crafting list. It is declared shapeless because weaving four tufts of fiber has no meaningful arrangement — any four slots do.

Vanilla has no recipe that returns a container, because its only container recipes (Cake, Honey Block) need milk, sugar, eggs, wheat or honey, none of which exist in Voxelhaven. This original recipe keeps the wiki's remainder semantics reachable in real play: a water bucket wets loam until turf grows on it, and the empty bucket comes back. Turf is otherwise unobtainable, since mining it yields loam the way vanilla grass does.

unsupported.reason: Voxelhaven ore blocks drop themselves and are smelted directly, the way its existing coal ore already behaves.
Voxelhaven's mesher only builds full cubes and crossed billboards, so non-cube block models do not exist.
No mob drops, farming or fluid chains for these; Voxelhaven's only mob loot is Fiber.
There is no redstone simulation in Voxelhaven.
Only one metal line (iron) is implemented, which is what the brief asked for.
No dye, clay, nether or ocean content exists, so these whole material families are absent.
Utility and combat items Voxelhaven has no mechanics for: farming, fishing, ranged combat, pets, storage or cartography.
Workstation blocks with their own GUIs; Voxelhaven ships a crafting table and a furnace only.
No hunger, brewing or farming systems, so food and potion items have no effect to attach to.
Further full-cube building blocks or second-tier stations that would add texture variants without adding a mechanic; excluded to keep the shipped item set purposeful.
